v1.name: Ground
v1.blurb: Light beige ground with a single white sheet. Coral underline on one word, the activate rule, pill button. The calmest of the four and the closest to the landing page body copy.

v2.name: Graphite band
v2.blurb: Graphite header and footer bands taken from the early-access strip, with a 2px coral rule. Drawn cards and the graphite filled button. Strongest brand presence.

v3.name: Sphere
v3.blurb: The grainy spheres from the hero behind a light-to-bold headline with a coral full stop. Centred, airy and the most editorial.

v4.name: Pixel
v4.blurb: Built from the square devices: code digits in drawn tiles, the Turn progress bar for expiry, numbered steps in the reset. Most structured.
